note: The sealings name the Udayagiri (Jajpur) monastery Madhava(pura), not Puspagiri: evidence against putting Puspagiri (10.09.02) at Udayagiri in the Assia hills, an alternative to Mizutani's Khandagiri (study: Khandagiri, probable). Lalitgiri, 8 km off, remains the stronger Assia-hills candidate (Lalitagiri stupa noticed by Xuanzang, IAR 1985-86, coded at 702); its monastery here is post-Gupta, consistent with the 7th c.
